note: Hand-written for #4675 (the north rebel outpost on the island). The site is the scout's of #4218 (docs/everon/places/outpost-north/site.md): no building stands in 120 m, so the one slot is a hostless plot (#3666) and the camp kit (#4555) anchors on the plot centre with every row resting on the probed ground. Approved with the card by the lead's standing rule (no maintainer approval since 2026-11-18). Moved from plot p3 (a meadow falling 8 m to the sea) to the flat plot p1 on the plateau on 2026-11-24: the probed rows fall 0.65 m across the camp; the self-imposed 4 km minimum became about 3.9 km (the nearest row is 3.92 km out).

why: free plot p1 (50 x 56 m, ground 15.1 to 16.9 m) on the plateau west of the meadow: the camp moved here from p3 (#4675 follow-up) because p3 fell 8 m toward the sea and the maintainer found the camp on a hillside; the kit stands on the plot centre and covers about 20 x 20 m of it, about 3.92 km from Saint-Philippe at its nearest row (the earlier 4 km minimum was our own rule, not a game rule, and was relaxed to about 3.9 km for flat ground)

no road within 120 m: a car comes up the free strip p2 (x 7688, z 8237 to 8355) and crosses the south half of p1 to the gate, which faces south; the pines around the plateau hide the camp from the road
